searchText: For the reference, execution-spec-tests are filling blocks with invalid transactions with the expectation that the whole block is rejected during testing. That seems to be based on a flawed thinking... The block can be rejected for many reasons. Maybe the tx is (erroneously) accepted by the client but the resulting state root doesn't match whatever the block-builder stuffed into the block. So that must lead to false negatives There's no plan right now for a follow up call unless required. We came out of the meeting with some timelines and consensus on how we should launch it. Any links to notes or writeup about those timelines? 🙏 Notes with key takeaways & rough timeline for Holešky testnet genesis https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/814#issuecomment-1613224057
